scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --handle-input --restart-tries 5 -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently --kill-others --handle-input -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
